# Comparison advice fixtures

Curated synthetic inputs; provenance.json records exact originals, hashes and derivations. Keep these tracked. Tests must not read the ignored archive. The currency contradiction remains a historical factual failure. Current 4.50 correction, original 4.22 extraction and unresolved USD/EUR are preserved. Fixture changes require review; consuming them requires no live provider.

The `source` paths in `provenance.json` are historical identifiers for archived
originals, not links or files supplied by a fresh clone. The tracked fixtures are
self-contained regression inputs; running their tests requires no private records.
